title: Amazing Grace
description: A simple three-chord picking accompaniment in 3/4. Learn the pattern, two chord changes, then the whole song.

lessons.title: Amazing Grace - The Pattern on G
lessons.description: Learn six gentle plucks on one easy G shape.

lessons.title: Amazing Grace - The G and C Phrase
lessons.description: Add C and return to G without changing the right-hand pattern.

lessons.title: Amazing Grace - The G and D Phrase
lessons.description: Prepare open D, then practise the second phrase.

lessons.title: Amazing Grace - The Complete Accompaniment
lessons.description: Play the full sixteen-bar accompaniment with G, C and D.
